The EMC Shop the NSG 3060 mainframe and a variety of CDN's for immediate rental and shipment. 
The Teseq NSG 3060-1 Package is a Multi-function generator for Surge Combination Wave, Ring Wave, EFT/Burst, Dips Interrupts & Variations testing. Includes single phase 16 A CDN. The EMC Shop stocks the Teseq NSG 3060-1 transient generator for immediate shipment. 
7.2" color display, touch panel, wheel with step size keys, Start-Stop-Pause keys and virtual keypad for easy and intuitive testing 
Multifunction generator for Immunity testing in compliance with EN/IEC61000-4-4, -5, -11,-12,-29 and ANSI C62.41&45 
Up to 6.6kV Surge and Ring Wave, 4.8kV EFT/Burst, dips & interrupts testing, includes single phase 16A CDN (CDN3061-C16). 
Includes PQM 3403 module to perform interrupt (drops) tests only. 
LAN/ETHERNET Interface - Win3000 PC Software 
programmable EUT power ON/OFF feature as well as internal temperature monitoring and automatic overload/overheat switch off
